name: Securities Account 21
definition: Unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

ReportingCurrency.name: Reporting Currency
ReportingCurrency.definition: Currency chosen for reporting purposes by the account owner in agreement with the account servicer.

ForeignExchangeRate.name: Foreign Exchange Rate
ForeignExchangeRate.definition: Foreign exchange rate applied between the reporting and base currencies. It is assumed the valuation date is the same as the report date.
